macros.name: quotetextcatcodedefs
macros.doc: Allows to set custom catcodes for parsing of quotetext contents.

macros.name: quotetextend
macros.doc: This command gets called at the end of the quote environment. It may be used e.g. to add space, a horizontal rule, or add other formatting goodies.

macros.name: quotetextfont
macros.doc: This macro contains the formatting commands to set up the quote font.

macros.name: quotetextstart
macros.doc: This command gets called at the beginning of the quote environment.

envs.name: quotetext
envs.doc: Stuff which you want to display verbatim, but with automatic white space formatting and text re-flow.
